title: QUIC RFC 9000 STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED Send-Only Receive Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P13-0002 requirement-home tests, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers receiver-side STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED policy for receive-capable streams, opened send-only streams, and uncreated send-only stream IDs on the protected Application Data runtime path.
expected_result: The requirement-home tests show receive-capable streams accept STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED without error, opened send-only stream IDs produce STREAM_STATE_ERROR at the bookkeeping seam, and protected STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED packets targeting opened or uncreated send-only stream IDs transition the runtime to Closing with a local STREAM_STATE_ERROR close and triggering frame type 0x15.
procedure: Run the focused S19P13-0002 requirement-home filter.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The existing STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED parser and formatter remain the wire-shape seam under test elsewhere.
The existing QuicConnectionStreamState receive-capability resolver identifies local unidirectional stream IDs as send-only for this endpoint.
The protected Application Data runtime has 1-RTT open packet-protection material.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED parser/formatter closure beyond the existing S19P13 0003 through 0008 proof and does not claim S19P14 STREAMS_BLOCKED behavior.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S19P13-0002 requirement-home filter passed, the Release build passed, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S19P13-0002 trace_clean, SpecTrace core validation passed, and git diff --check passed.
